Klasse RecipeIngredient

java.lang.Object
org.schmuh.quisine.entity.RecipeIngredient
@Entity public class RecipeIngredient extends Object
Entity class representing the relationship between a recipe and its ingredients.

This class is mapped to a join table that represents the many-to-many relationship between recipes and ingredients. Each instance of this entity links a recipe with an ingredient and specifies the amount and unit of the ingredient used in the recipe.

  • id: The unique identifier for the recipe-ingredient relationship (primary key). Generated automatically.
  • recipe: The Recipe associated with this ingredient in the recipe. This is a many-to-one relationship with the Recipe entity.
  • ingredient: The Ingredient used in the recipe. This is a many-to-one relationship with the Ingredient entity.
  • amount: The quantity of the ingredient used in the recipe.
  • unit: The unit of measurement for the ingredient (e.g., grams, cups, tablespoons).

Annotations:

  • Entity - Marks this class as a JPA entity that will be mapped to a database table.
  • Id - Marks the primary key field of the entity.
  • GeneratedValue - Specifies the strategy for generating the ID value (auto-incremented).
  • ManyToOne - Defines a many-to-one relationship between RecipeIngredient and the Recipe and Ingredient entities. The relationships are mapped via the JoinColumn annotation which specifies the foreign key columns ("recipe_id" and "ingredient_id").
  • JoinColumn - Specifies the foreign key column names used to establish the relationships with the Recipe and Ingredient entities.
